findings.title: StatefulSet update stops at its partition
findings.cause: StatefulSet cache's pod template has changed, and none of its 2 pods runs it: its rolling update has partition 2, at or above its replica count, so the update reaches no pod

evidence.what: StatefulSet cache: partition 2, current revision cache-856bc7c797, update revision cache-847dfc6486, 0 of 2 pods updated
evidence.command: kubectl get statefulset cache -n kd-statefulset-partition -o jsonpath='{.spec.updateStrategy}{" "}{.status.currentRevision}{" "}{.status.updateRevision}{" "}{.status.updatedReplicas}/{.status.replicas}'

findings.fix: Lower the partition to roll the change out further (0 updates every pod), once the pods above it look healthy; kubectl rollout status statefulset/cache follows it.
